headline: Weathered Expanse Tilts Colonial as Farranac Front Erupts
war_summary: Three hours past our last edition, the Weathered Expanse has tilted sharply Colonial: six of its nine works now fly Colonial colors against three Warden, the old deadlock broken and the ruined post reclaimed. Farranac Coast has flared anew — five exchanges inside two hours about The Bone Haft and Transient Valley, with Warden losses there running near one and a half times the Colonial count. Stlican Shelf remained in play to the last minute of filing, Fort Hoarfrost its storm center; one Warden work has gone over, narrowing the count to five against four. In the Linn of Mercy the ruined work is back on the Colonial roll, all eleven standing, though Warden losses there keep mounting. Godcrofts holds its place as the busiest map — twenty flag actions in two hours — yet all nine works remain Warden-held. Stonecradle has fallen silent these seven hours, still five to four, while Callahan's Passage, quiet in the ledgers of ownership, stays the war's costliest field with better than 10,000 Colonial and 7,600 Warden losses in the day. The ledger stands at 287 Colonial works to 145 Warden, two in ruin; near 38,800 Colonial and 45,100 Warden dead these twenty-four hours. Day 239, and no victor declared.
